# GotCOS

> Open-source AI chief of staff. The harness, memory, and context layer you own around rented AI models. Created by Miles Ukaoma.

## Field guides

- [What is an AI harness?](https://www.gotcos.com/harness/): the model is rented, the harness is yours — memory, files, rules, and skills around any frontier model
- [The AI Adoption Index](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/): how many people actually use AI — survey-anchored, source-tiered, updated July 2026
- [Context engineering vs prompt engineering](https://www.gotcos.com/context-engineering-vs-prompt-engineering/): the real shift — engineering the system around the model, not the sentence
- [Embodied intelligence](https://www.gotcos.com/embodied-intelligence/): a cited visual history of intelligence moving from screens to wearables, autonomous roads, and useful robots
- [AI chief of staff vs human chief of staff](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-chief-of-staff-vs-human-chief-of-staff/): what changes when the briefing layer is software
- [COS Glasses docs](https://www.gotcos.com/docs/): user guide for the G2 smart-glasses client
- [COS Control Docs](https://www.gotcos.com/control/docs/): the Mac user guide: setup, permissions, the eight Activity views, dictation, Mac meeting recording and live meetings, Work, Sessions, settings, troubleshooting and release notes
- [COS Control for Mac](https://www.gotcos.com/control/): the Mac companion that runs the open-source server and opens an Activity window with eight views: messages, speakers, meetings, memories, threads, agent sessions (including local Claude Code/Codex token history; 7/30/90-day calendar windows and custom dates; provider/model lines or stacked bars; provider, token and daily breakdowns; API-equivalent estimates distinct from subscription allowance), Work (existing tasks grouped by domain with confirmed meeting links and recorded handoffs), and Dictation (on-device Mac dictation with Parakeet Ultra or local Whisper, Fix a word and the COS dictionary)
- [COS Blueprint](https://www.gotcos.com/blueprint/): a 12-question, role-based build plan for your AI chief of staff
- [Glasses Challenge](https://www.gotcos.com/challenge/): win a pair of Even G2 glasses by showing what you would do with your chief of staff on the lens, not a raffle

## Open data

- [adoption-surveys.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/adoption-surveys.csv): generative-AI adoption by survey wave — Pew, Reuters Institute, Google-Ipsos, Microsoft WTI (percent, 2023-2026)
- [provider-milestones.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/provider-milestones.csv): dated user and revenue milestones per AI provider, with trust tier — not additive across providers
- [us-state-btos.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/us-state-btos.csv): share of US businesses using AI by state — Census Bureau BTOS
- [eu-enterprise-ai.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/eu-enterprise-ai.csv): share of EU enterprises using AI by country — Eurostat isoc_eb_ai

- [btos-state-series.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/btos-state-series.csv): biweekly share of US businesses using AI, Sep 2023 - Jun 2026, national + every state (Census BTOS)
- [eurostat-country-series.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/eurostat-country-series.csv): annual share of enterprises using AI, 2021-2025, 35 European geographies (Eurostat)

Compilation CC BY 4.0 (cite "GotCOS AI Adoption Index"); underlying figures belong to their publishers. Compiled 2026-07-15.

## COS Glasses 6.10.654 in the Glasses Hub; Even Hub lists 6.10.653

COS Glasses 6.10.654 is the current companion pack: the versioned package and canonical alias in the Glasses Hub repository (October 24, 2026). Even Hub lists 6.10.653, Public on the Even Hub marketplace since October 24, 2026. 6.10.654 makes phone lists (Past days, a day's chats, a chat's messages, Sessions with nothing cached) and the Views meeting answer build up in place while they load, then land readable and tappable from the first frame; every layout shift equals 6.10.653, Reduce Motion shows no wireframe, the lens is unchanged, and there is no new server requirement (tested with server 6.90.0). 6.10.653 adds Tailscale self-heal on the phone: fresh reconnect retries, and with server 6.89.0 or newer the stuck-Tailscale message waits 90 seconds so the Mac can repair the link, then the lens says Reconnected (the Mac fixed the link). 6.10.652 adds a plain stuck-Tailscale message and meeting saves that wait for the phone's audio (honest transfer integrity with server 6.88.0). 6.10.651 keeps the live transcript on the lens the whole meeting, with the phone locked, and puts Work on the lens. Published server is 6.94.2. Saved Mac profile matching needs two independent coherent long audio windows and names supported spans only; it does not train profiles or silently rewrite historical recordings. Anonymous voices can still split across long gaps or contain mixed speakers; full-call deduplication is not established. Public COS Control is 0.5.352, Developer ID signed and Apple notarized; it pairs with server 6.94.2. 0.5.352 sorts Settings into ten categories with search and an On this page list, gives many settings shorter names that search still finds by the old ones, keeps Use classic Settings (General, Advanced) for the old page, makes Roll back server ask first in Settings, and fixes dragging the session pet on macOS 27.2. Mac recordings show Saving, then Saved, when you stop them; meetings recorded from the iPhone microphone show in Control when the server switch COS_IPHONE_MICROPHONE_MEETINGS=1 is on with Parakeet Ultra as the HQ engine, and the COS Glasses companion offers it (microphone only, not iOS system audio); speaker ID (anonymous Voice 1, Voice 2) is on by default for Mac recordings and turns off with COS_MAC_LIVE_VOICES=off on the server, and a Voice can be assigned to a person in your voice profiles after a preview, with Rename only as the default when the match is flagged. Sessions Usage defaults to Last 30 days, with 7/30/90-day calendar windows and inclusive custom dates, provider/model lines or stacked bars and provider, token and daily breakdowns. Missing history and unknown pricing remain explicit; totals are local records, not subscription balances or bills. Windu one-session run bursts have matching cadence; failed cast loads can retry after a backoff. The cause of the reported repeated-lineup behavior remains unconfirmed. COS no longer types um and uh said on their own, before it types or copies, also with AI polish off; it does this only for English, and paths, file names and handles keep them (Settings, Dictation, Remove um and uh). A dictation at the start of a text box or sentence starts with a capital, never in terminals or for words like iPhone, handles or paths (Capitalize sentences). When you still hold Command or Control as Claude's polish arrives, COS waits up to 1.2 seconds for you to let go, then 600 milliseconds with no key down, before it swaps the polished text in, so it swaps in more often. Undo polish, on the pill and the card, puts back what COS typed. One line under AI polish says which polish the server runs for the model you chose (server 6.92.0). When an edit only repeats what Claude's polish had already done, the card says so and COS learns nothing; every edited card says what happens next time. If the microphone fails to start, COS tries one that has delivered sound since the update and Settings says which it used, and a sound or mute that hits an audio error pauses for 10 minutes, with Play sounds again and Mute again. Server 6.92.0 keeps polish steadier (Control giving up on a slow polish no longer counts as a failure, and a failing glasses meeting no longer turns off message polish), limits G2's prompt edit to 200 a day with short errors such as Edit limit reached, and stops the filler pass from removing German and Portuguese words or damaging paths. Server 6.91.1: the meaning check reads clock times, so a time format you asked for is kept. It includes 0.5.344: with AI polish on Claude Sonnet and server 6.91.0, dictation can learn a few style habits from your edits: it drops a filler phrase from a fixed list after you delete it in two dictations and follows your contraction habit. In 0.5.344 it learned only from dictations where Claude's version was swapped in; since 0.5.345 it also learns from the others. The pill says Learned your style, with Undo, and Settings, Dictation, Your style adds, removes or resets rules, turns learning off, and offers Previous polish (v3) to go back. Style rules apply only to Sonnet polish. Sonnet uses the new polish (v4): better at self-corrections, told never to add an em dash or an arrow, with a meaning guard that keeps COS's cleaned text (fillers removed) instead of Claude's answer when polish would lose a number, a date, a name or a negation. Haiku and Luna are unchanged. Learn from my edits tries to read the text box again when you press Return or click, counting key presses only, never which keys; this needs a single-key dictation shortcut such as Fn, and it saves nothing rather than an older copy. It also includes 0.5.343: while a view loads, it draws the outline of its rows where the rows will sit, then fills in with your data instead of a spinner; Reduce Motion turns the outline off. And it includes 0.5.342, which confirms your edits to dictated text: the pill says Edit saved and the dictation card shows what changed and whether a word went to your dictionary, and 0.5.341: distinct Jedi 360 animations, shuffled opponents and safe stock-pack upgrades, Mac Voice N labels, text-only Rename voice and Learn from my edits in Slack. It dictates into any Mac app on this Mac, records Mac meetings with a live transcript and Live COS Ask, and plans Work chat assignments for review before they are sent. Start at https://www.gotcos.com/control/: download, move to Applications, open, connect a signed-in AI provider, Get started, Open Sessions. Core server setup bundles Node/npm and requires no Homebrew/npm/npx installation. Local voice setup downloads verified, signed and notarized Whisper tools inside Control without Homebrew. Optional media features have separate dependencies. Since Control 0.5.278 the Mac shows a Live now meeting transcript, with Jump to live and Copy transcript; live text and speaker matches are preliminary, and saving opens the saved record. Control 0.5.282 with server 6.70.0 adds Live COS Ask beside the live transcript: presets and typed questions answered from the current meeting first, with COS memory and earlier meetings for typed questions; question and answer history saved per meeting; files and screenshots shared in the meeting, with their text read on the Mac; the Meeting assistant model under the Ask box and in Settings (Haiku by default); Copy full context; and sources that open where they came from. Public web search normally uses typed public-topic words. Server 6.71.5 also supports explicit consent to select public keywords from recent transcript passages for fact-checks and cost comparisons; private details are withheld. Companion 628 exposes the choice and remains a private device-test candidate. The menu bar and Dock show when a meeting records.

[HUD and signal guide](https://www.gotcos.com/docs/#hud-states): Messages uses ◈ Msg; Sessions uses ↔ Sess and its native Claude, Codex or Cursor identity. Continue uses that session's settings, independent of Messages. A model name is shown only when the session reports it. Messages, Sessions and live Meetings use up for history and down toward live. Home is last in footer actions and first in default COS side shortcuts, beneath Display off. Returning Home leaves recording and jobs active. Known battery is in navigation; live footers keep elapsed time, cancellation and history + Ask.

Working animates the connected COS nodes; explicit completion fills a circle. Separated dots indicate lost contact, pause bars waiting, a speech bubble a question and a hollow shield an approval request. Transient display delays pause and retry decoration; text has priority. Website signal frames are generated from 587 source, with fictional teaching content and illustrative timing.

[Phone meeting and voice review](https://www.gotcos.com/docs/#phone-review): Views, Review meetings on phone, meeting, Review voices. The phone stays monochrome. Read formatted notes, play retained timestamped samples, search saved voice profiles, explicitly choose an existing profile or a new person, and confirm the change. Saved names only enroll reusable voice samples when eligible evidence exists. Pending corrections are not automatically applied on reconnect.

[Offline boundaries](https://www.gotcos.com/docs/#offline-field): Sessions says Saved on phone only after acknowledged exact readback. Full queues retain existing turns and preserve the new draft. Older instructions become Needs review; held turns prevent bypass. Unreadable storage says Unavailable. Build 587 clears the queued placeholder when the Mac confirms delivery through normal polling; delivery is not model completion. Missing receipts remain pending. Broader Messages/task retention, standalone phone voice recording and durable unsynced audio across app relaunches remain upcoming or device-unqualified.

Final dictation cleanup on the glasses offers Haiku (default), Sonnet or Luna; choose Sonnet for the newest polish, the meaning check and Your style. Haiku and Sonnet use Claude CLI and Luna (GPT-5.6 Luna Fast) uses Cursor CLI. Haiku has been the default since glasses 6.10.616; Sonnet and Luna arrived in glasses 6.10.573 with server 6.61.5. Failed cleanup preserves transcription.

Server 6.61.4 fixes canonical merged G2 review lookup and adds revision-guarded task-name/finish-line writes. Since Control 0.5.265, the Mac app includes the responsive branded task editor and cache/resize hardening. Work 579 is a separate unpublished candidate and is not part of 587.

The current COS Glasses companion pack in Glasses Hub is 6.10.654 (Even Hub lists 6.10.653), and needs Even App 2.2.10 or newer; on Even App 2.2.9, 607 is the newest build that installs. 624 adds Meeting Ask on the phone and the lens (623) with a model switch in the Ask chat (624): presets, typed questions on the phone, history kept by COS on the Mac, and a MEETING ASK reader on the lens that never uses the microphone. MEETING AI still only starts and stops recording. Meeting Ask needs server 6.69.0; public web search needs 6.70.0. 624 also includes Scan code on your Mac pairing (621), a circle that fills before hold to talk records (622) and hold to continue a Cursor session (620). It retains the 599 framed activity reader and 600's server-described Continue behavior, keeps the clock and date on the Messages nav line, shows the battery in the nav only, no longer shows "status unknown" on Home, keeps the working mark moving while a reply streams, names the session on a session page, opens Sessions from a 4-second ring hold on Home, keeps a session page's status row, brings Home weather back after a missed lookup, transcribes dictation on the phone when the Mac is unreachable, also in Mac only, keeps believable preview words when the phone's final text comes back empty, shows a filling ring while the ring is held on Home, and shows a sending arrow while a send goes, with the lens status marks mirrored on the phone. Server 6.62.1 and newer include provider parity, hook-readiness cancellation, safe Cursor continuation, private current-request binding, and precise failed-fork recovery. Server 6.63.0 added background forks, and published server 6.63.1 keeps the last good Home weather across a server restart: a fork started with a client id answers at once, its outcome is read later, and a repeated id never makes a second copy. Older glasses retain Cursor Ask behavior unless they support the Continue note. The 623 and 624 build notes record Meeting Ask tested against a fake COS, not yet on a phone and G2 with a real server. Home/pet exact running-count parity is still open. 624 is a sideload, not a marketplace submission. 623 is its package rollback with the same server; earlier versioned packs remain in the Hub repo. 587 remains the last user-reported submitted marketplace build; approval is pending.

Control 0.5.285 adds evidence-confidence notes, collapsed unavailable-model details and optional Jev setup that no longer blocks the reminder. Server 6.71.5 supplies accepted finalized transcript passages to new saved-meeting answers and preserves historical quotes. Timestamp and progressive-refinement canaries remain disabled. Companion 628 adds public-topic consent and a native bridge error-loop fix; it remains a private acceptance candidate, and public companion 624 stays supported.
